Self.Wiki: Occlusion box (formerly Muffling Box; the game's CSMsbPointOcclusionBox). A room of the sound occlusion graph. Its Occlusion Portals are the openings, and routes (Muffling Portal Link / Muffling Box Link) join the portals. In Elden Ring the map's .onav file is compiled from these boxes and portals, so changing them may not affect in-game sound until the ONAV is rebuilt.

BoxNumber.Wiki: The number of this room. Several boxes can share a number, which makes them one room. Occlusion Portals give the number of the room they belong to.
